name: Citadel Outlets
description: Citadel Outlets is Los Angeles' premier outlet shopping destination featuring over 130 global brands and restaurants in a distinctive Assyrian palace-themed architectural setting. Located just minutes from downtown LA, LAX, and Southern California attractions, this open-air center offers savings on top brands including Coach, Nike, Levi's, lululemon, Michael Kors, The North Face, and more. The center features unique attractions like the World's Tallest Christmas Tree and regular events including nightly snow shows during the holiday season.
summary: Los Angeles' leading outlet shopping center featuring over 130 global brand outlets and restaurants in a unique Assyrian palace-inspired architectural setting.
